in_marathi.name: Bishwa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord, Master, Ruler
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bishwa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bishwa is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bish-wah’, meaning 'Lord, Master, Ruler'. It is a revered and esteemed name in Hindu culture, symbolizing power, authority, and leadership.
